task.title: Record the failure-analysis step-relevance change on L5b and L1
task.objective: At 407d6080 buildFailureAnalysisRequest reads each event's collector step stamp against the failed step (failedStep, earlierStep, afterFailure, unknown): after-failure events are ranked last and never primary evidence, and lines state their step only when steps differ, so single-step requests are byte-identical. On the real Qwen3.5-0.8B the eleven-row labelled set is unchanged at baseline 9/11, AI 9/11, 2 false attributions, 1 correct decline (every event there is in the failed step), and two new step-provenance cases score AI 1/2 against the baseline's 2/2 on both runs: the model ignores the step labels. The AI does not beat the baseline, so ROADMAP rule 7 keeps the automatic analysis off; the benchmark is 7/7 current, GO on all 8. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the change, the result and what stays open. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the change commit and its live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes` (the first attempt at awkit-djnl.8's was refused by the guard for its semicolons and rewritten without them), `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` (303 issues) and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: step-relevance change noted on awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
